theorems.name: Submission.p03_eds_torsion_kernel_card_68cf3476_d4
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Finite {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0} ∧ Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0} = n ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted finiteness, two-torsion cardinality, and cardinality recurrence results. Induction on consecutive positive indices yields the square cardinality.
